titulo: Ohio's Vivek Ramaswamy slammed for 'revolting' campaign ad featuring opponent's estranged mother
cuerpo: Republican Vivek Ramaswamy's team has confirmed that it produced a controversial advertisement featuring the estranged mother of his Democratic opponent in Ohio's gubernatorial race — and that the campaign will spend $4 million US to promote it despite facing bipartisan rebuke for dredging up Amy Acton's painful childhood.
